in_marathi.name: Tankadhar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Tanks
in_marathi.long_meaning: Tankadhar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Tankadhar is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Tank' meaning tank or reservoir, and 'Dhar' meaning to hold or sustain. This name is associated with the deity Lord Indra, who is known as the God of Rain and the protector of tanks or reservoirs.
